name: 23233 · Henrico, VA
findings: ZIP 23233 (Henrico) has 112 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23233 (Henrico) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 23233 (Henrico) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 62 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.
